units.source_text: 夕雾无可奈何，只得装作住惯的样子，安居在这宫邸内当主人。

en.t: Yugiri had no choice but to pretend that he was used to living there, and settled into the mansion as its master.

units.source_text: 三条院的云居雁闻讯，心念这回情缘决绝了。

en.t: When Kumoi no Kari at Sanjoin heard the news, she thought that this time their bond of love had truly been severed.

units.source_text: 但犹信赖夕雾，希望不致如此。

en.t: Yet she still trusted Yugiri, and hoped that it would not come to that.

units.source_text: 既而又想：“谚云：‘老实的人一变心，完全变作另一人。’

en.t: Before long, however, she thought again, "As the proverb says, 'When an honest person changes heart, he becomes a completely different person.'

units.source_text: 顿觉看破世情，不肯再受丈夫的气。

en.t: She suddenly felt that she had seen through the ways of the world, and refused to suffer any more humiliation from her husband.

units.source_text: 便以趋避凶神为借口，回娘家去了。

en.t: So, using the need to avoid an unlucky deity as her excuse, she went back to her parental home.

units.source_text: 其时适值弘徽殿女御归宁，姐妹相会，亦可稍稍解忧，

en.t: At that time the Kokiden Consort happened to have returned home as well, and the sisters' meeting helped ease her sorrow somewhat,

units.source_text: 就不像往日那样急急思归。

en.t: so she was no longer as anxious to go back as she had been before.
